name: Maite Cleaning Services
website_check: Google Maps listing shows 'Add website' (no website button), only a jotform.com intake link and the phone number. WebSearch for the exact business name plus Homestead FL found no owned domain, no Instagram, no Facebook. The only loose match (a Care.com profile for an individual 'Maite A.' in Opa Locka) is a different, unconfirmed listing and was not treated as this business.
hours: Mon-Fri 7 AM-5 PM, Sat 8 AM-2 PM, closed Sunday

source_of_data.discovery: python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "house cleaning service" --location "Homestead, FL" (daily discovery batch)
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> rating 4.9, reviews 57, phone, hours, website:null, owner note in Spanish
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 5 unique verbatim reviews, all 5 stars, in English
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 45 -> 7 unique Google Maps photos (business album), visually curated one by one with Read tool; 5 kept (2 excluded: a face-on profile shot and a grimy drain close-up)
